notes:
- New perk: Bomber (light purple). Your own explosions can't hurt you, every melee hit goes off with a
  small blast, and you carry 2 more grenades. Its upgrade trees: Big Bang (bigger, harder melee blasts) and
  Bandolier (up to 3 more grenades).
- New perk: Ice King / Ice Queen (named after the body you picked). Getting hit freezes every zombie
  within 6 m solid for 4 s (every 45 s; bosses are only slowed). Your grenades become Blizzards: an
  icy ball that bursts into a 6 s snowstorm, slowing everything inside and freezing it solid within
  about 2 s, with light frost damage. Upgrade trees: Permafrost (longer freezes and storms) and Cold Snap
  (freeze ready up to 24 s sooner).
- Weapon upgrade tiers. The upgrade machine now takes an upgraded gun further: Tier II for 15,000
  (half as much damage again, more ammo, a molten red-gold camo) and Tier III for 30,000 (double the
  first upgrade's damage, bigger mags, faster fire and reload, a dark-matter camo) plus an effect for each
  gun type: explosive rounds (pistols, shotguns), chain lightning (SMGs, LMG, minigun), cryo rounds
  (assault rifles), ricochet (snipers), bigger blasts (launchers).
- Family Home bedrooms have their own walls now, with a doorway into the rest of the house (the
  wall stops beside the loft stairs where they pass). Pictures hang on the new walls too.
